form_analysis.feedback: Exceptional aftercare form for vitiligo laser therapy with comprehensive guidance on repigmentation stimulation and photoprotection. Strong emphasis on the extended treatment timeline and realistic expectations.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for excimer laser therapy for vitiligo (308nm UVB). Stimulates melanocyte migration and repigmentation in depigmented areas. Requires extended treatment series with careful sun protection.

instructions.general_directive: Follow throughout lengthy treatment series (6-24 months). Vitiligo repigmentation is slow and requires consistency.

sections.title: Vitiligo Laser Mechanism
sections.content: 308nm excimer laser targets vitiligo patches to: 1) Stimulate residual melanocytes 2) Reduce local immune response 3) Encourage melanocyte migration from hair follicles or borders.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Response
items: Repigmentation begins as tiny freckles within patches.

sections.title: Photoprotection (CRITICAL)
sections.content: UV exposure can worsen vitiligo or cause burns in depigmented skin. 1) Sunscreen SPF 30-50+ on ALL exposed skin daily 2) Protective clothing 3) Avoid tanning of surrounding skin which increases contrast.

sections.title: Monitoring Repigmentation Patterns
items: Follicular repigmentation: Speckles around hair follicles.
Take monthly photos to track progress.
Some areas may not respond (lips, fingertips).

sections.title: Realistic Vitiligo Expectations
items: Stable vitiligo responds better than active/spreading.
Segmental vitiligo may respond better than generalized.
Not a cure - maintenance may be needed.

sections.title: Maintenance & Stabilization
sections.content: After repigmentation: 1) Gradually reduce treatment frequency 2) Continue photoprotection 3) Monitor for recurrence 4) Consider topical maintenance therapy. Vitiligo may reactivate with stress, illness, trauma.
